name: Program
excerpt: A Program is a group of related projects managed in a coordinated manner.
notes: A Program consists of related projects managed together to obtain benefits not apparent if managed individually. It is not necessarily a megaproject, which is a single large project over $1 billion.
context_summary:
- A Program is a group of related projects.
- Programs are managed in a coordinated manner.
- Benefits are obtained that are not apparent when projects are managed individually.
